source: Trilliant Health ORIA parsed hospital MRF DuckDB files
method: DuckDB standard_charges + optional standard_charge_details (allowed-amount percentiles) + CMS hospital fuzzy match (name/state/zip); rescan of local cache merged into existing extract
note: Prices are as published in hospital MRFs, parsed by Trilliant Health. For full nationwide coverage, download the consolidated archive from https://oria.trillianthealth.com/full-data-download
